title: The Assistant's overview again counts open questions and reviews as waiting on the user, and the failing test passes

fields.why: Pre-existing failure found while testing assistant-acts; separate from the relay work

text: tests/run.mjs check 'an open question and review wait on the user' (assistant block) fails on clean HEAD 91ed63f too. genlock overview --all as the Assistant shows alpha only as 'alpha (today) | 3 sessions: 2 working, 1 finished | session on ...', without the question and TO REVIEW: 2 lines. Likely from T-2AAH6's rewrite of sessionLines/briefLines in lib/overview.mjs. Fix the code so what waits on TJ shows. node tests/run.mjs takes ~3 min. Commit by path only.

Intermittent, not a steady regression: failed on clean HEAD 91ed63f (442/443) and on the working tree (461/462), but passed in a third run on the staged tree (462/462, now a7ef6d3). Find what makes it flaky (timing? session state 'working now' hiding the waits line?) as well as fixing the output.

fields.user_said: yes commit and push. and yes spinoff to fix the test

text: The cause of the intermittent failure is identified from an observed failing output, not guessed
check: manual: failing output captured and the cause traced to a line in lib/overview.mjs

text: When a project's goals and tasks cannot be read in time, the overview says so instead of silently dropping what waits on the user
check: manual: run overview with a forced snapshot failure and see an explicit line

text: The check 'an open question and review wait on the user' passes in repeated runs of the assistant section
check: node tests/run.mjs passes 3 times in a row with no overview failure

evidence: lib/ask.mjs:25 userQuestions lists by listIds (random Q- id order); overview briefLines took the last as 'newest'. Repro: 3 questions in 10 fresh projects, id order put a non-latest question last in 7/10, so the test's /Answered already/ matched only when its random id sorted last

text: Cause: questions listed in random id order, overview took last as newest. Fixed in lib/overview.mjs with byAsked (sort by at) in briefLines, workLines, sweep. Repro 10/10 after fix. Req 2 (snapshot timeout) was a disproved hypothesis: null snap already prints 'could not read'. Suite runs pending.

evidence: My own speculative requirement, disproved: the failure was id ordering, not a slow snapshot, and a null snapshot already prints 'could not read its goals and tasks' (lib/overview.mjs briefLines first line). Nothing the user asked for is dropped.
node tests/run.mjs after the fix, 3 runs in a row: 472 passed, 0 failed each (scratchpad run2-4.txt). Old code would pass all 3 by luck ~1/27.

answers.observed: repro: 10/10 fresh projects name the last-asked question; 7/10 had a different question last in id order; suite 472/472 x3
answers.cause: measured: lib/ask.mjs:25 lists by listIds (random ids), overview took the last as newest
answers.absence: questions were never missing from the count; only the 'newest' text was wrong, which is what the regex matched
answers.assumption: ask 'at' timestamps differ between questions; two asked in the same millisecond still tie (sort stays stable, falls back to id order)
answers.falsify: a suite run failing 'an open question and review wait on the user' after this change
